organization.tagline: AI-first web & mobile, Supabase backends, Balochi language tech.
organization.note: Public brand assets live under balochdev.com/brand/

hubAndSpokeMark.usage: Default mark on Mist / light UI (Baloch Dev logo — ink).

favicon.usage: Browser tab icon; coral hub-and-spoke mark.

wordmark.description: The site renders “Baloch” / “Dev.” as styled text next to the SVG mark using Neue Machina (same face as headings/body tokens; Syne/Chakra as fallbacks). Prefer the SVG mark + this wordmark from balochdev.com for partner materials.

cssDesignTokensReference.file: /src uses theme.css (build-time — see repository); production sites read tokens from deployed CSS variables.

typography.selfHostedBrandFont: /fonts/Neue_Machina_Font_Family/neue-machina-regular-400.otf (@font-face format opentype; WOFF2 optional for smaller files)
typography.note: Licensed .otf works in browsers via @font-face; convert matching weights to .woff2 for production if desired — see theme.css.

do: Use official SVGs from this folder or canonical URLs under https://balochdev.com/brand/
Keep clear space equal to roughly half the mark’s width around the logo
Pair mark with sufficiently contrasting backgrounds using the recommended theme pairing
avoid: Recoloring the hub-and-spoke network except via the supplied variants
